itens.resumo: Whether you play Pauper, Pauper Commander, or you just enjoy rifling through the draft chaff of a set for hidden gems, Common and Uncommon are sometimes the most exciting cards in a set. Reality Fracture brings some great Commons and Uncommons, so let’s check them out. REALITY…
